title: AI-Generated Image Detectors Exploit Global Artifacts: Evidence from Inpainting Exchange
abstract: arXiv:2602.00192v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Modern diffusion-based inpainting enables realistic, localized image manipulation, raising critical challenges for reliable detection. We show that state-of-the-art AI-generated image detectors largely fail to identify \emph{what} was synthesized and instead exploit a \emph{global} artifact introduced as a side effect of the generation pipeline: latent-diffusion inpainting passes the entire image through a VAE encoder--decoder, inducing a subtle but pervasive spectral shift even in unedited regions. We turn this observation into a simple, model-free diagnostic, \emph{Inpainting Exchange} (INP-X), that restores the original pixels outside the edited region while preserving all synthesized content. To study the effect at scale, we build a benchmark of $30$K matched real, standard-inpainted, and exchanged triplets ($90$K images) spanning four datasets and three inpainters. INP-X requires no model access and is a single compositing

translated_title: AI生成图像检测器利用全局伪影：来自修复交换的证据
translated_abstract: 现代基于扩散模型的修复技术能够实现逼真的局部图像编辑，这给可靠检测带来了重大挑战。我们证明了最先进的AI生成图像检测器在很大程度上无法识别被合成的具体内容，而是利用了生成管线副作用引入的一种全局伪影：潜空间扩散修复会将整幅图像通过VAE编码器-解码器，即使在未编辑区域也会引发细微但普遍存在的频谱偏移。我们将这一观察转化为一种简单的、无需模型的诊断方法——修复交换，该方法在保留所有合成内容的同时，恢复编辑区域之外的原始像素。为了大规模研究这一效应，我们构建了一个基准数据集，包含30K组匹配的真实图像、标准修复图像和交换图像三元组（共90K张图像），涵盖四个数据集和三个修复模型。INP-X无需模型访问权限，是一种单一的合成方法。
tldr: 该论文发现最先进的AI生成图像检测器实际利用的是扩散修复管线中VAE编码-解码带来的全局频谱偏移伪影，而非识别被合成的具体内容，并提出了无需模型的INP-X诊断方法来验证这一现象。
en_tdlr: This paper reveals that state-of-the-art AI-generated image detectors exploit a global spectral artifact introduced by the VAE encoder-decoder in latent diffusion inpainting pipelines rather than identifying what content was synthesized, and proposes a model-free diagnostic called Inpainting Exchange (INP-X) to demonstrate this phenomenon.
